drawio_review_note: Aligned with SFE arXiv:2506.10521 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendix E; official PrismaX-Team/sfe repository. SFE is built in three paper-defined phases. Experts first identify high-value directions in astronomy, chemistry, earth, life, and materials science. Two to five experts per discipline then map concrete tasks to signal perception, attribute understanding, or comparative reasoning and to MCQ, exact-match, or open-question formats. Native scientific data in 17 formats are rendered into images; experts author the VQA pairs, translate them into English and Chinese, cross-review scientific correctness, and apply rule-based format checks. The final set contains 830 VQA pairs across 66 tasks. Zero-shot evaluation uses temperature zero and reports text similarity or LLM-judge scores, with execution success and IoU for grounding tasks, broken down by discipline, cognitive level, and language.
